selection_rule: For each scenario and cap, choose the lowest candidate threshold satisfying floor(cap * negatives) false positives in EACH source separately. Candidates are 0, all distinct observed scores, and nextafter(max score, +infinity). Equal scores cannot be split.
purpose: Exploratory operating-point study, not deployment approval or an unbiased performance estimate.
no_alert_rule: Explicitly mark zero predicted positives across observed validation; never present this as a successful detector.
uncertainty: Caps constrain observed counts only. No population FPR guarantee, independent confidence interval or minimum-recall acceptance target is asserted.
